Happy Couples

I believe every wedding holds a universe of emotion — the nervous excitement before the mandap, the tearful embrace with parents, the stolen glances between two people beginning their forever.

My mission is simple: be invisible enough that you forget I’m there, and talented enough to capture every moment that matters. When you open your album five years from now, I want you to feel everything all over again.

Based in Mumbai, I work with couples across India — and for extraordinary love stories, I travel internationally.
